Probably not. A general bar on assigning "the contract" is usually read as barring only delegation of the distributor's performance, and under UCC §2-210 and §9-406(d) (assuming a U.S. UCC jurisdiction) an anti-assignment term generally can't block transfer of the right to payment. The treatment center may still pay the distributor until it gets notice of the assignment and could claim breach damages under the clause, and the result depends on governing law and on whether the clause expressly covers payment rights.

CONFIDENCE: 70
